title: Keep the primary checkout parked at origin/main so nobody works in it
goal: The primary checkout sat on a stale branch and an agent (codex/worktree-branch) committed in it, bypassing the worktree workflow. Add scripts/park-primary.sh: fetch, and if the primary checkout is clean and everything on its branch is in origin/main, detach it at origin/main (main itself is checked out in the integration worktree, so it cannot sit on main); refuse and explain when it has uncommitted or unmerged work. scripts/susi-worktree.sh runs it. workflow-guard and 'susi workflow check' already refuse commits there. Tests in tests/park_primary.rs against real temp repos.
